title: Nested tensor-coordinate extensionality for a scalar Roos map
statement: For the nested completed scalar extension in the scalar Roos construction, equality of the strict unshifted coordinates on all nested scalar tensor generators implies equality of those unshifted coordinate morphisms in every degree.

source.place: Proposition 3.5.1 and Stacks 0941; tensor-balancing and sheafification step

proof.text: For each degree and strict Roos product coordinate, apply the nested scalar tensor component extensionality theorem. Product extensionality then gives equality of the first Roos coordinate morphisms.

proof_origin.place: Proposition 3.5.1 and Stacks 0941; tensor-balancing and sheafification step
